newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Foreign funds raise investment in Colombian stocks.
newsitem.headline: Foreign funds raise investment in Colombian stocks.

text.p: Investment in Colombian stocks by the 175 foreign funds authorized to operate in Colombia was up 16.9 percent in September over the same month last year, the country's Securities Superintendency said.
In monetary terms, it said the increase marked a $1.02 million rise over September 1995.
The 15 funds authorized to buy Colombian ADRs or GDRs abroad had investments totalling $484 million as of September, the superintendency said in a statement.
